purpose: Maps every frozen §5 clause to the machine rule that expresses it. The denominator is ADR_CLAUSE_INVENTORY.json, frozen in an earlier commit and hash-bound below; this matrix cannot widen or narrow it.

entries.requirement_text: Second Brain is an extension/control plane
projection/spool/purge coordination does not confer authority
extension can be disabled without canonical-store migration
approved action has exact canonical target
policy filtering occurs before model context
confidential/restricted semantic indexing disabled in v1
projection derives from canonical snapshot revision
LocalSpoolPort exists as a machine interface contract
CustodyPort exists as a machine interface contract
confidential/restricted disabled until verified encryption/key ownership
searchable residual count must equal zero before success
OpenLoopCandidate exists as a machine data contract
TaskProposal exists as a separate machine data contract
TaskPromotionRequest exists as a separate machine contract
task mutation requires Leantime + Task Orchestrator proof + explicit approval
multi-project background capture disabled until isolation proof
immediate interruption only for: privacy, identity, data-loss, irreversible-action, authority-conflict
